styleLock.direction: premium velvet matte K-beauty cushion commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm ivory #F4ECE3 for infographic and proof panels, a muted rose-taupe #EFE7E2 and soft peach #F4D9C2 for scene and chart shots, one deep plum-charcoal #3A2A2E for the flat-lay accent, and seamless #FFFFFF for the hero packshot
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft beauty studio light, large front diffuser with gentle fill, sweeping side skim for texture, low-contrast shadows and controlled soft contact shadows, no harsh specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte velvet paper and pale stone counters in warm beige tones
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, generic thin labels only, in-image marketing copy stripped to blank slots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-line icons in rose-brown, empty badge and seal outlines with no text
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight high three-quarter hero angle, matte velvet cushion finish readable, generic identity-neutral persons with soft crops, hex-pinned swatch gradients
noDrift: no brand marks or readable source labels

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium velvet-matte K-beauty cushion visual system across the entire image set; fixed warm palette of velvet ivory #F4ECE3, rose-brown #A9614C, matte wine #5E2233 and caramel beige #E4C6A4, seamless white #FFFFFF for the hero packshot and a deep plum-charcoal #3A2A2E flat-lay accent; warm soft beauty studio lighting with a large front diffuser, gentle fill and a sweeping side skim for texture, low-contrast soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with generic thin labels only; thin single-line icons in rose-brown with empty badge and seal outlines and no text; matte velvet cushion finish kept legible with a stable slight high three-quarter hero angle and hex-pinned swatch gradients; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no brand marks, no invented numeric claims.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底干净合规展示气垫本体与粉扑。

shots.lighting: bright even high-key warm studio light, large front diffuser with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the compact
shots.props: a fanned foundation swatch smear and a round velvet applicator puff, minimal
shots.promptTemplate: High-key e-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight high three-quarter angle, the open compact centered with its domed lid tilted back, a fanned foundation swatch smear behind it and a round velvet applicator puff resting at the lower right. Bright even high-key warm studio light with a large front diffuser and gentle fill, and a soft contact shadow grounding the compact; seamless warm-white field #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. An optional {selling_point_1} slot marks a single benefit without rendered copy. Negative: no brand marks, no readable label text, no shade number, no watermark, no hands, no cluttered props, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：源 10 图为韩系丝绒雾面气垫粉底套图——01 白底开盖气垫+粉扑+色膏扇形拖样；02 人物持装左、右侧三行图标信任卡；03 四格多肤色手持色号卡阵；04 顶视空标签色卡网格；05 深底顶视多气垫芯阵列带扫码；06 三行质地成分分栏；07 三格同框妆列；08、09 双分栏同框妆前妆后特写；10 四段手臂色阶带。品类判定依据：主体为带粉扑的开盖气垫粉底，着色彩妆底妆属性明确，归 美妆彩妆 / 底妆，源类目路径亦指向该域无冲突。已剥离内容：源品牌字标、系列名与店铺角标、气垫与卡面刻字、色号编号与色名（本模版一律不写入编号）、持妆时长与零氧化、纯素、销量好评数与奖项徽章、成分名与功效断言、扫码图形、模特面容与身份；相关主张改用 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 空槽，色板与信任卡以空白单元表达，产品全程以 {product} 占位。
